# Open Historia

> AI-powered grand-strategy history game — command nations through natural language.

## Public pages

- [Rewrite history, one order at a time](https://historia.aliveville.com/index.md): Command nations across human history with natural-language orders and an AI Game Master.
- [Start an alternate history](https://historia.aliveville.com/play.md): Choose a scenario and command a civilization with natural-language orders in Open Historia.
- [Steer history, one order at a time](https://historia.aliveville.com/about.md): Learn how Open Historia combines natural-language strategy, an AI rules engine, and rewindable timelines.
- [Privacy](https://historia.aliveville.com/privacy.md): How Open Historia handles sign-in identity, private saves, provider requests, and deletion.
